messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads up — RadiantHealth QBR locked Tue 4/12 10am PT. Need a 10-slide deck + 1p one-pager for execs. Deck draft: https://drive.redwood/radiant-qbr-v1 (please don't edit master)

Jonah Reed: grabbing slide owners. I'll take 'Customer health & adoption' slide

Priya Singh: I'll do 'Reliability & infra' — can someone pull p99/p50 latency and error rate for last 30d? Preferably as a small table.

Lucas Ortega: I'll own 'Renewal signals & risk' + exec ask. Also looping in Erika for alignment with their stakeholders @Erika Zhao

Erika Zhao: thanks @Lucas — confirmed CEO + CTO will attend. Focus on adoption, top blockers, and cost/ROI talk.

Priya Singh: quick query I ran, feel free to paste in slide:
```
SELECT percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p99
FROM inference_requests
WHERE model='redwood-large' AND timestamp > now()-interval '30 days';
```

Maya Patel: Slide 7 (Onboarding gaps) — need 3 short customer quotes & 2 action items. Jonah, can you surface quotes from last two weeks of onboarding surveys?

Jonah Reed: on it. Pulling survey IDs 4231, 4278. Will paste snippets by EOD.

cs-bot: Reminder: QBR deck template v2 uploaded to channel assets by @Maya

calendar-bot: Event 'RadiantHealth QBR' created — Tue Apr 12 17:00 UTC (attendees: Maya, Jonah, Priya, Lucas, Erika)

Maya Patel: We should run a 30-min dry run Fri 4/8. Who can make it? :raising_hand:

Priya Singh: I can. Jonah?

Jonah Reed: yes, free after 11am PT

Lucas Ortega: I can join final 20 mins.

Maya Patel: Great — I've added a checklist to the deck's comments: final metrics, 1p exec-readout, backup demo video, rollback talking points. Please ✅ when done.

Erika Zhao: noted. Also, customers have asked about data residency — can we include a blind slide on Private deployment options? 1-2 bullets.

Maya Patel: good call. Priya/Jonah, add a single slide under 'Security & Compliance' with bullet: 'Private (VPC/on-prem) overview + next steps'

Jonah Reed: will add. ETA Thu EOD.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — aim to close action items by Thu 5pm PT. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
